readable.text: depots and shops
depots are upstairs
BRONZE GATE\nSand Pit\nLow risk. Groups: stand on the platform.
SILVER GATE\nStone Coliseum\nMedium risk. Groups: stand on the platform.
GOLD GATE\nThrone of Fire\nDaily boss + rare weapon.
THE CRUCIBLE\nLever: today's bosses and occupied arenas.\nReturn to the temple: southern portal.
NATURAL ISLAND\n3 Cyclops camps\nThree-floor cave: the Queen
DARK CATHEDRAL\nRuins and a two-floor crypt\nFrom Bandits to Dark Monks
ELVENBANE\nA seven-floor elven fortress.\nFrom orcs and elves to the tower dragon.
BEAST VALLEY\nFour floors of challenging hunts\nFrom Minotaurs to Demons
INFERNO PITS\nFour floors of fiery caves\nFrom elementals to Furies
THE CRUCIBLE\n3 gates. Daily boss.\nBronze / Silver / Gold
WAVE ARENA\nJungle Clearing: 20 waves (lvl 25-100+)\nGroup challenge. Time ranking & weekly rewards
SAND CLOCK\n6-wave time attack\nClear waves for extra time & daily reward
CULT FORTRESS\nThe fire warlocks no longer pray to anyone.
HELL ISLAND\nNorth: the Crossroads. West: Ash Fields.\nEast: Lava Rivers. Beyond: the Fortress and the Crater.
THE CROSSROADS\nWest: Ash Fields. East: Lava Rivers.\nNorth: Cult Fortress and the Crater.
THE MAW OF HELL\nGate: level 80. Hellhounds hunt below.\nIn the Abyss, the Ashlord's gate requires level 100.
NORTH PASS\nForest, Frozen Tundra and Dragon Caves.\nCaves: level 60+.
FROZEN TUNDRA\nWinter Wolves, Polar Bears and Trolls.\nA yeti is said to roam the lake.
DRAGON CAVES\nExperienced hunters only.
NORTH PASS\nNorth: Frozen Tundra and Dragon Caves.\nSouthern portal: Retro76.
Hunters' camp.\nRest by the fire.
IMPERIAL CASTLE\nEach floor is harder than the last.\nImperial Heroes and treasure await at the top.
A lumberjack once lived here.\nHe left something for whoever found his hideout.
FROST GROTTOES\nIce Spiders and, in the depths, a dragon.\nLevel 80+.
ISLE OF ETERNAL ICE\nThe trail heads north: Snowy Forest, Frozen Lake,\nFrost Monastery and the Grottoes.
FROZEN LAKE\nCross the ice passage. An islet lies to the west:\na yeti is said to live there.
FROST MONASTERY\nThe ice monks show no mercy to intruders.

DESERT RUINS
Ruins (8+), southern dunes (10+), lagoon and oasis (15+),
bandit camp (20+), scarab nest (30+),
lizard temple (40+), bone field (45+),
swamp (50+), djinn sanctuary (60+).
Follow the stone path.
Ship at the dock: pirates on deck (25+).
WAVE ARENA\nJungle Clearing: 20 waves (lvl 25-100+), boss every 5.\nGroups: stand on the platform and pull the lever.
WEEKLY RANKING\nCleared waves count; fastest time breaks ties.\nWeekly rewards (coins + gems): 5 / 10 / 15 / 20.
Left: next wave (clear the room first).\nRight: retire to camp and save your score.
MINOTAUR CAVE\nStronger minotaurs await on each floor below.\nReturn portal at the end of the third floor.
Portal to the mainland (temple)

NATURAL ISLAND
Follow the trail past three
Cyclops camps
to the cave at the end.

STONE CAVE
Golems, Shamblers and
a descent to Wyverns.
The Queen awaits in the depths.
THE FORGOTTEN PIT\nCave entrance (level 20+).\nEnter through the trapdoor.

THE FORGOTTEN PIT
A former PvP arena, now hunting caves.
Level 20+: take the eastern stairs down.
3 floors. Return portal at the end.
Exit to the city: northern ladder.
DAMP GALLERIES\nLevel 20-45.\nBelow: Deep Caverns.

DEEP CAVERNS
Level 45-80.
Beware of Quaras and Golems.
Below: the Heart.
THE HEART\nLevel 70+. Pharaoh guardians.\nIn the depths: Orshabaal (level 100+).
ORSHABAAL\nLevel 100+ boss.\nBring a group. Return portal at the far end.
FERRYMAN'S TOWER\n5 floors, one monster per floor.\nTortoise -> Thornback Tortoise -> Crab -> Quara -> Predator.
QUARA CAVE\nQuara Constrictors, Mantassins, Pinchers,\nHydromancers and Predators.
CATACOMBS\nUndead: Ghouls, Vampires, Mummies\nand Necromancers.

VALLEY CROSSROADS
West: Minotaur Camp.
East: Cyclops Quarry.
North: Ancient Ruins and caves.

BEAST VALLEY
North: Valley Crossroads.
Minotaur Camp (west), Cyclops Quarry (east),
ruins and caves (north). Southern portal: temple.
ANCIENT RUINS\nNot all the dead rest in peace.
DRAGON LAIR\nDragons, Wyrms and a Black Dragon.\nVeterans only.

ELVENBANE
A seven-floor elven fortress.
Enter the cave: the tunnel leads
to the castle basement.
Northern portal: temple.
DESCENT TO ELVENBANE\nA long tunnel to the basement.\nTrolls, Orcs and Dwarfs.
TROLL DEN\nEnter the hole: River Trolls near the ladder\nand Stone Trolls among the rocks at the far end.

SAND CLOCK
6-wave time attack (90 s starting sand).
Each cleared wave adds bonus time and advances in 5 s.
Clear all 6 waves for Chronos daily reward.
Exit: southern portal.
DARK MAGE TOWER\n6 floors of increasingly powerful mages.\nThe Dark Mage awaits at the top.
EMBER FIELD\nFire Devils and Fire Elementals.
THE PIT MOUTH\nGate: level 90. Ash Pits below.\nThe Heart at the far end requires level 100.
THE FORD\nWest: Ember Field.\nNorth: the Pack and the Pit Mouth.
INFERNO PITS\nAshen wasteland above the pits.\nNorth: the Pit Mouth. Southern portal: temple.
THE PACK\nHellhounds among the rocks.
WEAPONS CHAMBER\nFour chests: each hero chooses one.\nGate: level 100.
PEW HALL\nOld pews and rubble.\nWest: the descent to the crypt.
CRYPT ENTRANCE\nTake the stairs down.\nDo not return alone.
CATHEDRAL NAVE\nOnly monks and the dead\npray here.

DARK CATHEDRAL
North: the nave.
Crypt entrances: in the jungle
and beside the grey hall.
This portal returns to the temple.

BRIDGE TOWER
6 floors in the middle of the river.
Pirates below, Quaras and Drowned creatures above,
each floor stronger than the last.
BLACK DRAGON HUNT\nEnter the hole and follow the tunnel.\nIf cornered, use the island's hole and climb back up.

IMPERIAL CRYPT
Squires and archers guard the entrance.
Imperial Heroes await at the far end.
A tunnel connects to the Black Dragon Hunt.
KONGRA TOWER\n3 floors. Kongras below;\nRed Kongras roar above.
SOUTH KONGRA TOWER\n3 floors; the strongest Red Kongras live above.
KONGRA WATCHTOWER\n2 floors. Red Kongras watch from above.
DARK HYDRA ISLE\nEnter the hole and follow the tunnel to the islet.\nIf cornered, use the islet's hole and climb back up.

EASTERN GLACIER
The trail heads east, growing ever colder.
Ice Dragons and Ice Spiders await at the end.
Level 60+.
WILLOW RUINS\nWest: scouts and arcanists.\nThe blue sanctuary lies at the far end.

PATH OF THE FALLEN
Zombies at the entrance,
Undead Gladiators
at the far end.
PETRIFIED SANCTUARY\nGargoyles and Golems at the entrance.\nCrystals and the Lake Custodian in the depths.
DWARVEN MINE\nDwarfs and Soldiers above.\nGuards, Geomancers and the Iron Foreman in the depths.
DEEP SEWERS\nLevel 8-20: Rats and Slimes below.\nBeyond: Mutated Sewers (level 25-45).
BLACK SILK NEST\nLevel 40-65.\nTarantulas at the entrance; Giant Spiders and Wyverns deeper inside.
CRYPT OF EYES\nLevel 30-65.\nGazers and Beholders at the entrance; Vampires, Vampire Brides and Banshees deeper inside.
SUBMERGED RIVER GROTTO\nLevel 45-75.\nBlood Crabs and Quara Constrictors at the entrance; Water Elementals, Quara Hydromancers and Bog Raiders below.
DEEP HALLS OF DEMONA\nLevel 75-120+.\nTwo wings below: Stone Wing (Behemoths & Wyrms) and Arcane Wing (Warlocks).
WEST: STONE WING\nCyclops Smith, Stone Golems, Wyrms and Behemoths.
EAST: ARCANE WING\nPriestesses, Necromancers and Warlocks. Watch your line of sight.
AMAZON CAMP\nLevel 15-30.\nAmazons, Valkyries and Assassins across the northern bridge.
BARBARIAN CAMP\nLevel 15-40.\nBarbarian raiders and Frost Giants across the northern snowfields.
